title: Privacy Policy
intro: Lumina Drops ("we," "us," or "our") respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect when you visit luminadrops.com or join a drop, how we use it, and the choices you have.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
body: Contact information you give us, such as your email address when you join the waitlist for a drop.
Order information collected at checkout, including your name, shipping address, and email. Checkout is handled by our payment processor, Stripe - we never see or store your full card details.
Website activity, such as pages viewed, interactions with the site, and information about how you arrived at our site, which may be collected through cookies and similar technologies.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
body: To process and ship your order.
To send order confirmations and updates about a purchase you've made.
To send occasional emails about upcoming drops, only if you've opted in.
To understand how visitors use our site and to measure and improve our advertising.
To respond to questions and improve the site.

sections.heading: Sharing Your Information
body: We don't sell your information. We share only what's necessary with the service providers who help us operate Lumina Drops, process payments, fulfill and ship orders, understand site activity, and measure the effectiveness of any potential advertising.

sections.heading: Cookies
body: Lumina Drops uses cookies to keep the site running smoothly. We may also use third-party analytics and advertising technologies to understand how visitors interact with the site, measure the effectiveness of our advertising, and help us reach people who may be interested in Lumina Drops.

sections.heading: Your Choices
body: You can unsubscribe from marketing emails at any time using the link in any email we send. To request a copy of your information, or ask that we delete it, contact us at hello@luminadrops.com.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
body: Lumina Drops is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect information from them.

sections.heading: Changes To This Policy
body: We may update this policy as Lumina Drops grows. Any changes will be posted on this page with a new effective date.

sections.heading: Contact Us
body: Questions about this policy? Email us at hello@luminadrops.com.
